provenance.note: Commit identifies the base revision; nonempty worktree status means local changes. Source hashes identify the actual code/configuration used. Null git fields mean Git was unavailable.

scenario.name: sensor_fault
scenario.description: P1's sensor fails and then recovers on an empty path.

energy_scope: modelled lamp-only energy; auxiliary loads excluded
interval_convention: Each frame applies over [time_s, time_s + dt_s).

baseline.nighttime: Fixed brightness at each zone's cap.
baseline.sensor_dependency: None; sensor inputs are shared for comparison only.

assumptions.habitat_summary: Mean lux is weighted by interval duration. Exposure_lux_s = sum(artificial_lux * dt_s). Exposure_lux_h = exposure_lux_s / 3600. Peak lux is the maximum eligible interval reading. Zone means use equal weights per configured point; they are not area-weighted habitat estimates. Edge and corridor are summarised separately.
assumptions.power: power_w = rated_power_w * brightness_pct / 100. Power is assumed proportional to brightness. This assumption has not been checked against real lamps. Standby, sensor, controller and communication power are excluded.
assumptions.lux: Sum over lamps: full_output_lux_below * (brightness_pct / 100) * height_m^2 / (height_m^2 + horizontal_distance_m^2) * directional_factor
assumptions.directional_factor: For habitat measurement points, each lamp's calculated light is multiplied by its configured habitat_spill_factor. This also applies to the habitat-edge lamp. For other measurement points, the multiplier is 1. This is a simplified assumption based on the point's zone, not a measured physical shield or beam direction. Both fixed and adaptive lighting use the same multipliers.
assumptions.sensor_geometry: Ideal circular detection range; active agents move continuously. Agent type is not used.
assumptions.stale_rule: Unhealthy when no sample exists or sample age exceeds sensor_stale_timeout_s.
assumptions.agent_logging: Only active agents have position rows. An absent row means the agent is outside the environment.
exclusions: Ambient daylight and other light sources

limitations: Energy results apply only to the simulated duration.
Lower habitat lux does not demonstrate wildlife recovery.
Visibility and safety compliance have not been validated.
sensor_ok describes motion input health only.
daylight_ok describes availability of the shared day/night input.
Reliable daytime keeps lamps off despite motion faults.
Unavailable day/night input activates configured zone fallback.
The fixed baseline retains an independent scenario schedule; daylight-input-fault runs compare different input availability.
